Facility Inventory & Condition Assessmen.justification: Comprehensive district-wide inventory including detailed building sizes, ages, classrooms, portables, and specialized spaces (Sections G, H, Appendix C). Robust condition assessment using FACT tool with detailed scoring across all major systems and connection to long-term planning (Sections H, FACT analysis).

Enrollment & Capacity Planning.justification: Provides detailed enrollment projections over 10 years with methodology explained (cohort survival, birth data, migration rates) and integrates capacity utilization by site and grade with square footage and student counts (Sections F, Tables 8-10, 13-14). Connects projections to facility actions including consolidation and reconfiguration options.

Educational Alignment.justification: Includes educational mission and goals linked to facilities with some discussion of program-specific needs (CTE, special education, multimedia classrooms) and facility projects responding to these needs (Sections H, Vignettes). Coverage of programmatic shifts and educational specifications is partial and uneven.

Outdoor Spaces & Greening.justification: Mentions outdoor spaces such as playgrounds, sports fields, and some landscaping improvements (Sections H, Vignettes). Limited detail on greening strategies, shade coverage, or districtwide analysis of green space; no explicit connection to climate resilience or outdoor learning.

Climate Risk & Mitigation.justification: Acknowledges climate change impacts broadly in City General Plan goals (e.g., water conservation, climate adaptation) but lacks detailed climate risk assessment or specific mitigation strategies in the Facilities Master Plan (Section D).

Energy Efficiency & Resilience.justification: References some energy-related upgrades such as HVAC modernization, lighting improvements, and solar panels in CTE projects (Sections H, High School CTE). Lacks comprehensive energy use data, resilience strategies, or explicit reference to state mandates like Title 24 or Zero Net Energy goals.

Financial Plan & Capital Strategy.justification: Presents detailed financial analysis including state and local funding sources, bond capacity, developer fees, and state programs (Sections J, K, L). Includes prioritization of projects, cost estimates with unit costs, and funding strategies aligned with district needs and state programs.
